name: Weapon Mesh Scale Fix
author: vkays
description: Fills in the Render Scaling that six weapon MODEL.TXT files shipped without. Short Name=undefined plus Render Scaling=1 marks a metadata file nobody authored, and each of these sits beside a base weapon that carries a real value, so the variant renders up to 2x oversize. Includes MaceGreat, which is the shipped Great Mace's own mesh and 11% oversize in vanilla today. Built by mods/weapon-mesh-scale-fix/build.py from vanilla.
